## **Ads pressure** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Ads pressure.**
      2 recent review(s) mention ads pressure.
      Review window: Jul 30, 2026 - Aug 3, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users are noticing ad pressure. This can signal monetization friction and an opening for a cleaner competitor.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _82765_, Aug 3, 2026, 1/5: "You stink. Ads are one thing. Fine, they pay the bills. But forced full screen videos is insanity. You have competition and I'll switch in a heartbeat. Knock it off."
            2. _drawdraw300_, Jul 30, 2026, 1/5: "Every. Single. Update. I am nothing but disappointed. The UI becomes harder to use, and uglier. Not only am i getting more ads- but not when i want to log for one meal, i see every meal first. If i want to delete logs, i can no longer select to delete or mass delete them. I firmly believe the developers are now more interest in AI and money than the quality of their app, and the comfort of their customers. I will be switching apps. Thanks for ruining your app for your YEARS long customer who kept giving you chances."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      2 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Jul 23, 2026 - Aug 2, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Aspen262_, Aug 2, 2026, 1/5: "I’ve loved this app for years but the new update is horrible. It’s pushing AI, and leaving out lots of features that I loved. 3/4 tabs are unusable now. There’s a meal planner function that won’t even let you add regular white rice.. or any of your own recipes. Why would you make the app harder to use? I opted to cancel my premium subscription and try cronometer instead. Emails to the company have resulted in being told that I’ll get used to it. Try letting year long customers choose which version of the app they want"
            2. _Deanajk_, Jul 30, 2026, 1/5: "I don’t even know where to start all I know is I don’t understand why you would change something that wasn’t broken! I’ve been a premium user for 15 years!? There are so many things wrong with the new layout/UI/update, and I don’t have time to list all of them here. But if you’ve been a user for a while, then you already know. Please please please bring back some of the old features that you omitted with the update! I never thought I’d have to say that I’m considering other ways to track my macros for the first time in many many years. It’s a sad day for me! 😭"
            3. _TheJude69_, Jul 23, 2026, 1/5: "Basic features locked behind premium. Tells you your salt is over daily limit but won’t show you what logged foods are responsible without premium. This is pathetic. You can’t scan barcodes without premium. Money grabbing scum."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 18, 2026 - Aug 2, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Zahmed22_, Jul 25, 2026, 1/5: "I keep having issues I choose a goal after saving it - I’ll look at the diary and the calories have changed I’ve uninstalled the app and reinstalled no avail"
            2. _Paulidka_26_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "The new user interface completely ruined daily meal tracking. The calorie header disappears when scrolling, "remaining calories" is missing in the diary, and basic tasks now require way too many clicks. The previous layout was so much better, intuitive, and effortlessly easy to use. I have spent years building my custom recipes and meals here, but this update makes the app unusable. Please add a "Classic View" toggle in Settings, just like Light/Dark mode!"
            3. _Anne Dlh_, Jul 23, 2026, 1/5: "The application bugs from the first use. I do not recommend that you use an application that tells you to consume only 1400 kCal per day for a woman... You will obtain the opposite of your objective. You will disrupt your body and your mental health. And for some, developing TCA… Nice try but no thanks."
<!--/ir-theme-->
